append.observe: Delivered copies leave out what they would only repeat. In public_robot_facts a camera entry omits native_pixel_to_image_offset_xy when it is [0, 0] and image_view when it is that camera's own name; end effectors omit orientation_order and controlled_frame, because every pose is [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] of the controlled point the embodiment card names. In last_action_effect.detail an arm that was not targeted lists only its non-null fields, and its inactive_arm_drift only above 0.1 mm or 0.01 deg. A claim_boundary, evidence_scope or note whose fixed text a tool's description states is left out of that tool's results and effects.
append.move_pose: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: compiled_pose.targets.<arm>.observed_clearance.claim_boundary (move_pose, move_to, rotate_wrist and rotate_pitch) is "From the current depth images and their calibration only; points inside the measured jaws, the held object and the space above them are excluded as robot, other robot links are not; occluded surfaces and object undersides are unknown; points up to the footprint's top within radius_m count; not a collision check or a contact prediction, and the move is submitted unchanged."; compiled_pose.targets.<arm>.reach_along_request.claim_boundary is "Read-only IK at sampled points of the straight interpolation from the measured pose to the target; reachability is not proven monotone between samples, and no path, collision, payload or arrival claim. One CuRobo v0.7.8 IK solve per pose by the IK solver of the planner that move_pose's global segment uses, seeded from the measured joints or a chained query's solution, with joint limits and Panda self-collision only: no table, object or scene model. The solution's grip site is checked against the 0.005 m / 0.05 rad arrival bound. It plans no trajectory and does not model the bounded OSC route, so move_pose can still refuse or fail to reach a pose reported reachable, and a pose reported unreachable may still be reachable: the seed search is finite." for an unsolved target and, for a solved one, the same text from "One CuRobo v0.7.8 IK sol" on; reach_along_request.nearest_reachable_orientation.claim_boundary is "Read-only IK at each candidate endpoint by the same reach check as reach_along_request (its ik_model, matches_move_pose_admission and measured_disagreement apply), from the measured joints: the requested orientation turned about axes perpendicular to its approach axis, holding the jaw centre; no path, collision, payload or arrival claim, and an orientation outside the sweep may solve."; last_action_effect.detail.planning_diagnostics.note is "Counts overlap; raw joint bounds do not isolate self-collision or other constraints. World collision model is absent.".
append.vision_segment: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: the result's claim_boundary is "independent point-prompt proposals with a per-point mask budget; one point never consumes another point's masks, an empty point means no mask at that pixel rather than an exhausted budget, and omitted_over_* counts every mask withheld; inspect the proposals and choose semantic identity; crops add no sensor detail".
append.set_gripper: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: the action effect's gripper_outcome.claim_boundary is "stalled_before_target means the jaws stopped short of the commanded opening; it is consistent with an object between the fingers and is not proof of a grasp".
append.grasp_plan: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: ik_reachability.claim_boundary is "IK reference at planning time for the compiled pregrasp (free_space from the measured joints) and approach (contact_approach from that pregrasp solution), trying the exact orientation and its 180-degree jaw flip; not a guarantee. Execution runs its own backend check, and any world action stales this.".
append.wait_ticks: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: last_action_effect.detail.wait.claim_boundary is "time passed with commands held; drift, settling, slip or scripted scene motion are measured evidence in the fresh observation, not effects of this action".
